# Playbook operating rule

Keep executable, recurring procedures in `Playbooks/` using allocated `PLAY-####` IDs. Generate `Playbooks/index.md` from the canonical records. A Playbook is `current` or `superseded`.

Keep explanations, reference material and standards in Knowledge. When a Knowledge record owns a recurring executable procedure, review it and build a Playbook only where that distinction is justified. Supersede the source after the replacement validates and its live links migrate. Supersede any earlier discovery index only after its generated replacement and the required Playbook set are verified.

Playbooks organise evidence, decision questions, documentation and drafts. The owner makes live decisions and authorises external effects. Ask for material thresholds, timing, approvers and escalation routes when the live case needs them.
